candidates.shared_prompt: Do not send coordination messages. Act only from each hero's current local state.
Narrate plans and status continuously so every hero knows that coordination is happening.

role_prompts.barbarian: Acknowledge the support hero and narrate the action you are about to take.
role_prompts.wizard: Broadcast multiple planning updates before yielding the turn.

candidates.shared_prompt: Send one compact event-specific assignment, but do not change the underlying action policy.

role_prompts.barbarian: Follow the existing action policy after receiving the assignment.
role_prompts.wizard: Name the relevant role and action once, then yield.

candidates.shared_prompt: Execute the correct role-specialized joint action sequence without sending messages.

role_prompts.barbarian: Wait for support counterplay, carry the objective, and extract when positioned.
role_prompts.wizard: Reveal before breach and hand the objective to the positioned extractor.

candidates.shared_prompt: Send one compact, load-bearing message at a breach, carrier assignment, blocker, or extraction handoff. Name the responsible role and intended next action. Do not require a reply. After the objective is secured, prioritize extraction over optional work.

role_prompts.barbarian: Hold a breach until support counterplay is complete; carry or extract when assigned.
role_prompts.wizard: Reveal before breach, assign the carrier, and hand off the objective when the extractor is already on the escape tile.

candidates.shared_prompt: Use the same event-triggered protocol and action policy, but evaluate it with the communication channel masked.

role_prompts.barbarian: Take the assigned load-bearing action only after its matching coordination message is received.
role_prompts.wizard: Issue the same compact assignment from local evidence; the evaluator masks delivery.
